title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18.10 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 18.10 up to but not including 19.4.11, 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.9, and 19.6 up to but not including 19.6.2 could allow an authenticated user to perform server-side request forgery (SSRF) against internal network resources. This occurs due to insufficient URL validation in the MCP server OAuth handling. The issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
